key_interactions.effect: Regular paracetamol at 4,000 mg/day raised INR in some patients stable on warfarin (label).
May alter paracetamol metabolism and raise hepatotoxic potential (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid excess alcohol; keep within the maximum daily dose.
